messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands — can we get a short summary of why we won vs why we lost in Q1 and the concrete asks we should act on? Keep it tactical, please.
Arjun (Product): TL;DR from product reviews: wins = predictable latency, easy onboarding, strong evals. losses = pricing for bursty workloads, missing SSO options for some deals, and a couple model-quality regressions.
Sasha (Sales): +1 on pricing. A few mid-market deals balked at Dedicated commit size. Also Flex billing was confusing — customers thought they were paying per-run not per-token.
Leo (PM): Can we turn those into 3 product asks? My draft: 1) pricing tier for mid-market burst (monthly cap + burst), 2) improve billing UX + one-pager for customers, 3) fast SSO/OIDC rollout for Private. Thoughts?
Sean (CS): From support: lost signals also include unclear guidance on quantization impact and lack of quick best-practices for latency-sensitive prompts. Customers tried naive 4-bit and hit quality cliffs.
Maya: Good — leadership ask is: pick owners and timelines by end of next week. Prioritize one low-effort win + one medium project.
Arjun (Product): Owner suggestions: Leo -> pricing UX doc (low-effort), Sasha -> sales-facing billing one-pager (low-effort), Sean + Eng-ML -> quantization guidance + evals (medium). SSO -> Eng-Platform (medium-high).
Sasha (Sales): I'll draft the one-pager and send to pricing@ for numbers. ETA: Wed.
Leo (PM): I'll prototype a burst tier proposal and a simple calculator we can put in the console. ETA: Fri.
Sean (CS): For quantization guidance: short checklist + a reference prompt set and examples where 4-bit works vs fails. I can assemble with Eng-ML. ETA: next Tue.
DevOps-bot: Deploy note: created github issue #4821 for "billing one-pager" and #4822 for "burst tier calc".
Maya: Thanks — can we add a small metric to the roadmap card: expected revenue impact or number of in-flight deals influenced? Even a rough bucket (small/medium/large) is fine.
Arjun (Product): Adding revenue buckets to the pricing card now. Also, we should run a short postmortem for 3 lost deals to extract precise decision points — Sasha can assign.
Sasha (Sales): Will assign 3 deals by EOD. Will include the exact language that caused churn.
Leo (PM): One more ask from ops: include a "fallback model" recommendation in docs so customers know how to degrade gracefully when using smaller quantized variants.
Sean (CS): Agreed — that should be part of the quantization guide. I'll include sample config and a tiny snippet: ```json
{"model":"redwood-mini-q4","fallback":"redwood-base-float16","max_tokens":512}
```
Maya: Love the plan. Can everyone drop status in this thread when they hit the ETA? We'll review in next all-hands. :thumbsup:
Sasha (Sales): will do. :+1:
Leo (PM): dropping follow-up card in the roadmap board now.
Arjun (Product): I'll circulate the consolidated action list with owners after I sync with Eng-ML.
Sean (CS): Starting the quantization examples now, will ping Eng-ML for test harness.
DevOps-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up ping in 7 days.
